Data and citation

Each review rests on a register: every claim, goal, and commitment logged from the report, with its reading, its evidence, and its date. You can download it and cite a fixed version.

How to cite a review

Norantz (2026). España 2050: a second reading, version 1, reviewed as of 16 November 2026. Plural Futures. [address of the fixed version]

Always cite the fixed version address, which never changes, not the latest-version address.

Licence

[PLACEHOLDER] Licence for reviews and data not chosen (site architecture open item 3). Proposed for discussion: CC BY 4.0 for review text and registers.

How sources are extracted

One record per page or slide. Numbers are copied as printed in the source. Anything read off a chart or image is marked with "~" and never rated. Both the PDF page and the printed page are kept.

By Plural Futures

Norantz (Basque for “towards where?”) is a second reading of national futures, by Plural Futures. It reads each report on its own terms, describes rather than grades, and shows its sources, coverage, and method on every page.

Read generously. Check rigorously.
